> Let $f(n)$ be maximal such that if $A\subseteq\mathbb{N}$ has $|A| = n$ then $\prod_{a\neq b\in A}(a + b)$ has at least $f(n)$ distinct prime factors. Is it true that $\frac{f(n)}{\log n} \to\infty$?
